主要内容: Ally Financial and TIME announced Andy Crews of AutoFair Honda as the 2015 TIME Dealer of the Year. Crews was selected from 55 U.S. dealers at the NADA Convention & Expo. Ally will donate $10,000 to the winner's nonprofit and $5,000 to each regional finalist's charity. Ally also donated $1,000 to each of the 55 nominees' charities. The three regional finalists are Greg York, Michael Shannon, and Greg Goodwin. All nominees are featured on AllyDealerHeroes.com. The award recognizes top auto dealers with strong community involvement. Ally Financial Inc. (NYSE: ALLY) is a leading automotive financial services company with $149.2 billion in assets as of Sept. 30, 2014.
